## Bio

Laboratory informatics consultant with 17 years of clinical lab experience, specializing in workflow optimization and middleware solutions. I understand how labs actually run and how staff use their systems day to day, and I use that to improve processes and uncover the value in lab data. I apply R, Shiny and machine learning to that data, including a deployed prioritization app that replaced a manual process.
